name: ZCH_BATCH_DATA_ENRICH_REQ_DTLS
description: Table that stores the DAAS JOBS submitted for one enrichment job

columns.name: REQUEST_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Column displaying the unique request detail identifier, primary key for this table

columns.name: BATCH_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to BATCH_REQUEST_ID in table ZCH_BATCH_DATA_ENRICH_REQ

columns.name: DAAS_JOB_STATUS
columns.description: Column indicating the status of the DaaS enrichment job

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Column indicating the status of the chunk

columns.name: DAAS_JOB_ID
columns.description: Job ID submitted to DaaS for enrichment.

columns.name: IMPORT_JOB_ID
columns.description: Column indicating the import job id for the chunk

columns.name: DAAS_PROCESSED_RECORDS
columns.description: Number of records submitted to Daas in this batch

columns.name: DAAS_MATCHED_RECORDS
columns.description: Number of records matched in DaaS

columns.name: DAAS_REJECTED_RECORDS
columns.description: Number of records rejected for matching by DaaS

columns.name: DAAS_FAILED_RECORDS
columns.description: Number of records for which match was not found in DaaS.

columns.name: NUM_RECORDS_COMPLETED
columns.description: Number of Import completed

columns.name: NUM_RECORDS_ERRORED
columns.description: Number of import failed

columns.name: DAAS_ERROR_CODE
columns.description: Error Code returned by DaaS if job fails

columns.name: CHUNK_ID
columns.description: ID representing the data chunk that is part of the enrichment process.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
